subject: GNAP Bridge Initialized - Cross-Repo Coordination Active
body: Both Zeitnus and HSCSG_v15_OS now have .gnap/ directories with matching agents.json and task FA-1. Ready for cross-repo agent coordination via git. Next steps: 1) Push both repos to GitHub, 2) Verify heartbeat loop works across both, 3) Define shared task namespace for HSCSG assimilation work.
